name: Alía (Spain)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Alía (a wheel and a crozier on red).
history: The arms of Alía were approved by the Order of 23 June 1988 (Diario Oficial de Extremadura of 5 July 1988) and the flag by the Order of 10 February 2003 published in the Diario Oficial de Extremadura on 22 February 2003, approved by the Consejera de Presidencia María Antonia Trujillo.
